sources.entry: Mask This - Menu bar app that masks sensitive information in the clipboard. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/tseylerd/MaskThis) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: Mask This is a macOS menu bar app that uses on-device Apple Intelligence to detect and mask sensitive information in the clipboard as text is copied.
summary.what_it_does: Mask This runs in the background as a macOS menu bar application and watches the system clipboard for changes. When new text is copied, it sends the text to an Apple Intelligence on-device language model to identify sensitive information and replace it with masked text. The masked version is written back to the clipboard. The app has a menu bar item for quick access to settings and offers optional notifications that tell you when data has been masked. The README says processing happens locally on the device. The README does not list which types of sensitive data are detected.
use_cases: hide sensitive data before pasting into chats or documents
automatically mask secrets copied to the clipboard
prevent accidental pasting of personal information
local privacy protection for copied text on a Mac
notable: Uses on-device Apple Intelligence language models, so text is processed locally per the README
Lives in the macOS menu bar and monitors the clipboard in real time
Writes masked text back to the clipboard automatically
Optional notifications when data is masked
caveats: Deprecated: Apple deprecated Foundation Models adapters in macOS 27, and the app does not work on macOS 27 or later
Requires an Apple Silicon Mac with Apple Intelligence enabled in System Settings
The author reports that reliability is not good without the adapter
